q2_anthropic_accounting.method: Anthropic convertible notes were available-for-sale debt at fair value, with unrealized changes in AOCI (Level 3). Converted nonvoting preferred is not equity-method; recorded at cost/measurement alternative with observable-price-change or impairment adjustments to Level 3 fair value in Other income. This is event-based observable-price adjustment, not a routine quoted-market mark.
q2_anthropic_accounting.reclassification: Q2 10-Q gives $4.5B rounded H1 reclassification gains for note conversions in Q1 2026; it does not separately state a Q2-only reclassification. Q1 10-Q table records $4.479B in Q1. Do not add the H1 amount again to Q2 EPS.
q2_anthropic_accounting.other_income_components: Q2 other-income net total includes the $50.5B preferred mark plus other valuation, warrant, FX and reclassification items. SEC Q2 disclosure says $53.4B Q2/$69.1B H1 mainly from preferred-price adjustments and reclassification; it does not provide a precise standalone-Q2 reclass split.

q2_eps_denominator_and_tax.tax_rate_note: Derived provision / pretax income; Amazon says interim provision uses estimated annual effective rate plus discrete items and is updated quarterly. H1 included $15.9B discrete expense primarily from Anthropic valuation; standalone Q2 discrete amount not identified here.

post_q2_investments_and_updates.fact: Amazon invested $5B each in Series G and Series H Anthropic nonvoting preferred in Q2. The related facility was initially capped at $20B and the Series H investment reduced remaining facility availability to $15B.
Amazon invested the remaining $21.3B of its OpenAI Series C commitment after quarter-end; no post-June valuation or Q3 P&L amount disclosed in this source.

Subject to stockholder approval, 5% of Anthropic shares to be committed to a wholly owned public-benefit LLC; board may add 2% for each 50% rise in company value above an undisclosed baseline. The page gives no financing-round price/value or Amazon-specific accounting update.

financing_window_check: Targeted official-domain search for Anthropic/OpenAI financing surfaced OpenAI’s Feb27 $110B announcement and Mar31 close at $852B post-money, both before Jul1. The displayed Anthropic news index had Oct18 benefit-fund and other announcements, not a priced funding round. This bounded search does not prove no private or unannounced financing occurred Jul1–Sep30.
